title: Claude Fable 5.5 Just Got Leaked and It's INSANE
description:
Claude Fable 5.5 hasn't officially launched yet, but people already seem to be getting early access to it, and the results are insane. In today's video, I'll show you exactly how people are getting these Fable 5.5 results on the Claude website, how you can check if you're getting it too, and some of the most insane things people have already created with it.

We'll cover the Fable 5.5 leak and the knowledge cutoff test that started it all, along with leaked demos of high-quality animations with sound design, 3D physics simulations and games. You'll also see how these early Fable 5.5 results compare to Opus 5.5, and what this could mean for Anthropic's next flagship model, which is reportedly releasing as early as next week.
